title: Transpose Matrix
statement: Return the transpose: the matrix flipped over its main diagonal, so row i column j of the answer is row j column i of the input. The matrix need not be square, so the result may have different dimensions from the input.
constraints: the input is rectangular: every row has the same length
hints: The answer has cols rows and rows columns. Allocate it that way round before you write anything into it.
This is why Rotate Image can transpose in place and this cannot: a non-square transpose does not fit back into the original array.
One double loop, result[j][i] = matrix[i][j]. The whole difficulty is not muddling the two extents.
